# Underground Software Engineers of NYC
> AI generates. Engineers decide.

LLM-friendly summary of the [Underground Software Engineers NYC](https://underground-software-engineers-nyc.github.io/underground-software-engineers-nyc/) collective.

## Name

Underground Software Engineers NYC (the crew, the collective).

## Tagline

- AI writes the code. We design the tracks.
- AI generates. Engineers decide.

## Who

An NYC engineering crew building AI-accelerated software in production. Engineers, not decorators. Systems, not dashboards. Static-first, self-hosted, signed, operated in-house.

## How the experience works

The main site is deliberately gated. Entry is a signed physical QR artifact live in the city; it verifies in the browser before anything renders. No forms, no leaked portfolio.

## Public surfaces

- Collective site (this page): https://underground-software-engineers-nyc.github.io/underground-software-engineers-nyc/
- Gated main site (the presentation, the signal): https://underground-engineer-nyc.myfilebase.site/
- Applications (GitHub issues & PRs only): https://github.com/underground-software-engineers-nyc/underground-engineer-NYC-job-board
- GitHub org: https://github.com/underground-software-engineers-nyc

## Joining

Applications happen as GitHub Issues or Pull Requests on the applications repo (answers + portfolio in a gist or external link). Accepted engineers receive a signed crew pass. Everything else is public record.
